findings.expected: RelationshipValidationResult must require a canonical EvidenceRecord for relationship_observation before validation_ready.
findings.observed: Before H1B5.4 repair, evidence_refs alone were enough for evidence_ok, so missing EvidenceRecord could still become validation_ready.
findings.impact: Missing EvidenceRecord could be treated as ok, violating H1B5.4 silent fallback criteria.
findings.recommended_action: Require matching relationship_observation EvidenceRecord by candidate_id, observation_id or evidence_id.
findings.repair: RelationshipValidationPolicyService.validate_many now accepts evidence_records and blocks with RELATIONSHIP_CANONICAL_EVIDENCE_RECORD_MISSING when no matching canonical record exists.

findings.expected: H1B5.1 report mentioned RELATIONSHIP_CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED; H1B5.3 introduced RELATIONSHIP_CONFLICT_BLOCKED for readiness blocking conflicts.
findings.observed: CVL now predicts RELATIONSHIP_CONFLICT_BLOCKED, while SemanticSelfReview still reports RELATIONSHIP_CONFLICT_PRESENT for candidate evidence.
findings.impact: Not blocking: evidence-layer presence and readiness-layer blocking are distinct states, but the older H1B5.1 wording remains broader.
findings.recommended_action: Keep both semantics documented: PRESENT for evidence review, BLOCKED for validation readiness.

findings.observed: Helper is defined twice with equivalent implementation in the CVL service.
findings.impact: No behavioral drift observed; tests pass and both definitions use the same generic relationship tokens.
findings.recommended_action: Optional cleanup in a later hygiene slice; not required for H1B5.4.

findings.expected: Counts/status/reason_codes/ref counts only, no large candidates/evidence/provenance payload inline.
findings.observed: UniversalTaskSessionService summary includes counts, confidence summary, reason_codes, validation counters and source only.
